GRADUATION LIST 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
BUSINESS SCHOOL 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


METROPOLITAN YMCA 
OF MONTREAL 


June 20, 1963 


CEREMONIES WILL BE HELD MONDAY, JUNE 2hTH, FOR 188 
GRADUATES OF SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS BUSINESS SCHOOL. 
THERE ARE 91 GRADUATES IN THE DAY DIVISION AND 97 
‘IN THE EVENING. THE SCHOOL OFFERS A FULL TRAINING 
COURSE TO MEN AND WOMEN, IN BOTH DAY AND EVENING 
DIVISIONS, IN BUSINESS ARITHMETIC, BOOKKEEPING, 
OFFICE MANAGEMENT, STENOGRAPHY, AND TYPING. 


IT 1S THE OLDEST OF THE ORIGINAL YMCA SCHOOLS WHICH 
STARTED IN MONTREAL AS ONE OF CANADA'S FIRST PROJECTS 
IN EVENING ADULT AND VOCATIONAL EDUCATION IN 1873. 
FROM THIS SCHOOL HAS GROWN THE WHOLE COMPLEX OF SIR 
GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS*=STILL ONE OF 
CANADA'S BIGGEST PROJECTS IN FORMAL EVENING EDUCATION.
